scenes.title: simpligen VideoStudio
scenes.subtitle: Local video generation. Zero API cost.
scenes.narration: This is simpligen VideoStudio. A video generator that runs entirely on your own machine.

scenes.title: Write a scene file
scenes.subtitle: Title, narration, colours and an SVG diagram
scenes.narration: You describe the video as a short JSON file. Each scene has a title, a line of narration, and an optional SVG diagram.

scenes.title: Render locally
scenes.subtitle: Pillow draws, Kokoro speaks, ffmpeg encodes
scenes.narration: Pillow draws each slide and its diagram. Kokoro reads the narration. And ffmpeg times, fades, and encodes everything into an MP4.

scenes.title: Kokoro in Docker
scenes.subtitle: Natural voices, no API key, fully offline
scenes.narration: The voice you are hearing is Kokoro, an open weight speech model running in a local Docker container. If it is not running, simpligen falls back to the system voice.

scenes.title: What it costs
scenes.subtitle: $0 per render. Seconds of laptop CPU.
scenes.narration: There are no API keys and no per render fees. A one minute video costs a little laptop time and a fraction of a cent in electricity.

scenes.title: vs HyperFrames
scenes.subtitle: Slides + ffmpeg vs HTML + headless Chrome
scenes.narration: HyperFrames renders animated HTML in headless Chrome. simpligen trades that power for a tiny footprint and fast renders.

scenes.title: This video made itself
scenes.subtitle: python3 -m simpligen examples/demo.json
scenes.narration: This video was generated by simpligen, from the file you just heard about, and deployed to Fly. Thanks for watching.
